# pmax — Performance marketing agency, Mallorca

> pmax (PMax Online S.L.) is a performance marketing agency based in Calvià, Mallorca, Spain. We run Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, SEO, and AI search visibility programmes for European brands. Flat monthly retainer fees — no percentage of media spend, no conflicting incentives. Clients typically spend €5,000–€200,000/month on media. 93% twelve-month client retention. Multilingual: campaigns in up to 19 languages, site in EN/DE/ES.

## Services

- [AI Search Visibility (GEO)](https://pmax.online/services/ai-visibility/): How to get your brand cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews — entity graph, structured data, citation-worthy content.
- [Google Ads & Performance Max](https://pmax.online/services/google-ads/): Search, Shopping, PMax and YouTube — built from the signal up. Feed optimisation, Smart Bidding, CRM-fed offline conversions.
- [Paid Social](https://pmax.online/services/paid-social/): Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn — CAPI and Events API connected, creative-led, measured against revenue not impressions.
- [SEO](https://pmax.online/services/seo/): Technical SEO, content strategy, regional and multilingual SEO. Rankings that compound into AI citations.
- [SEO Company Mallorca](https://pmax.online/seo-company-mallorca/): Local and multilingual SEO for Balearic businesses — Spanish, German, English and Catalan. Based in Calvià.
- [SEO Agentur Mallorca](https://pmax.online/de/seo-agentur-mallorca/): Lokale und mehrsprachige SEO für Unternehmen auf Mallorca — Deutsch, Spanisch, Englisch, Katalanisch. Sitz in Calvià.
- [Agencia SEO Mallorca](https://pmax.online/es/agencia-seo-mallorca/): SEO local y multilingüe para negocios en Mallorca — español, alemán, inglés y catalán. Con sede en Calvià.
- [Google Ads Agency Spain](https://pmax.online/google-ads-agency-spain/): Google Ads agency based in Spain — Search, Shopping and Performance Max in Spanish, German, English and Catalan. Flat fees.

- [Agencia Google Ads España](https://pmax.online/es/agencia-google-ads-espana/): Agencia de Google Ads en España — Search, Shopping y Performance Max en cuatro idiomas. Tarifa fija, nunca un porcentaje de la inversión.
- [Marketing Agency Mallorca](https://pmax.online/marketing-agency-mallorca/): Performance-led marketing agency in Calvià, Mallorca. Google Ads, Meta, SEO and AI search for German- and English-speaking businesses. Flat monthly fee.
- [Marketing Agentur Mallorca](https://pmax.online/de/marketing-agentur-mallorca/): Performance-Marketing-Agentur in Calvià, Mallorca. Google Ads, Meta, SEO und KI-Suche für deutsch- und englischsprachige Unternehmen. Feste monatliche Pauschale.

## How we work

- Flat monthly retainer — client pays media directly to platforms; pmax never handles budgets
- Multilingual: campaigns in up to 19 languages; site and support in EN, DE, ES
- Server-side tracking, Consent Mode v2, GDPR and LOPDGDD compliant by default
- 93% twelve-month client retention
- First conversation: 30 minutes, free, no pitch
